Module Contents
---------------

.. py:function:: create_map(latitude: float = 46.3, longitude: float = 2.34, zoom: int = 6) -> ui.carto.folium.Map

   Instantiate a Folium map

   :param latitude: Latitude (North / South coordinates) of the center point of the map
                    Written in float : ex. 46° 51' 24''N ~ 46.86
                    Defaults to almost the latitude of the most beautiful city: 46.86.
   :type latitude: float, optional
   :param longitude: Longitude (East / West coordinates) of the center point of the map
                     Written in float : ex. 2° 21' 07''E ~ 2.34
                     Defaults to almost the longitude of the most beautiful city : 2.34.
   :type longitude: float, optional
   :param zoom: The zoom level of the map visualization.
                Defaults to the level adapted for France display : 6
   :type zoom: int, optional

   :returns: the instance reference of the created Folium map
   :rtype: folium.Map
